## Seat paused for 12 hours by the maintainer · 2026-11-18T03:29Z

The maintainer, verbatim, in this seat's session: 「暂停开发 12 小时后继续」. Development is paused for 12 hours from this stamp (until about 15:30 UTC): no dev, review or landing work runs, and no new card is dispatched (the earlier order 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」 still stands for after the pause). The hourly patrol (`trig_01VGfkscjtswUwd7ZprA2SdZ`) is disabled for the pause. A one-shot resume (`trig_013GoUdfT4vjFsYb5MzKVaBr`) fires at 15:30Z. Claims stay as they are; this seat is paused, not gone.

State held at the pause (waiting on the seat, nothing to take):
- #34662: PR #34935 at 1ce9b683e9. L1 delta ACCEPT 6965140367; CI green. Owed: a fresh at-tier L2 record (the 00:27Z claim lapsed).
- #34682: PR #34910. S1/S2 fix round paused mid-way (branch at 538121f231; seat ruling on S1 in 6963435977).
- #34638: PR #34999. L2 record 6963905172 (PASS, S1/S2 open); the fix round was paused before it pushed (branch at 9b417c941d).
- #34504, #34552, #34637: PRs #34964, #34970, #35002. L1 ACCEPT; L2 and the maintainer's approval owed (Tier H).
- Merged today: #34711, #34583, #34758, #34749, #34760, #34756. Closed: #34772.

## Pause restarted: 16 hours from this stamp · 2026-11-18T09:49Z

The maintainer, verbatim, in this seat's session: 「你还是暂停，重新计时，16小时后继续，处理完当前任务就下班。」 The pause restarts now and runs 16 hours (to about 01:49 UTC tomorrow). The resume trigger `trig_013GoUdfT4vjFsYb5MzKVaBr` was moved to that time; the hourly patrol stays disabled until then. After the pause the seat finishes the in-hand work, lands what can land and signs off. It dispatches no new card.

Taken into account since the last note: 18.6.0 shipped and the merge-queue freeze is lifted (triage 6971145268). #34910 will drop its edit to the released `.changeset/34441-…` and carry the correction in its own changeset (triage 6968769153). Seat 1 is now held by os-warren (mailbox #35105). Epic #34659 was restructured; none of this seat's cards are in it.

State is unchanged from the pause note 6968146834. Claims stay; this seat is paused, not gone.

## Pause ended early on the maintainer's order · 2026-11-19T00:32Z

The maintainer, verbatim, in this seat's session: 「继续处理，当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」. The pause ends now. The resume trigger `trig_013GoUdfT4vjFsYb5MzKVaBr` is deleted; the patrol is re-enabled for the wind-down. No new card is dispatched. The seat finishes the in-hand PRs (#34935, #34910, #34999), lands what passes, hands the Tier H PRs (#34964, #34970, #35002) on, and signs off.

The seat was vacant with a sign-off brief (body edit 2026-11-19T14:12Z, `check-handover.mjs` clear), so it is taken directly instead of opening seat 7; the brief is not an inherited ruling and its follow-ups (#35295, #35379, …) are outside `area:ai`, not taken.

Excluded: cloud cards (`domain:cloud`, e.g. #34411), security advisories, epics and `pm:epic` cards, untriaged cards, and cards another seat holds (#34869 and #34996 carry seat 3's `Claim:`; #33691 is named in seat 2's `o2-C` row).
- Mailbox: PR #35555 (subscribed; seat 4's old mailbox #34831 is closed). Patrol: `trig_016ZHFirW3X6Lc81JBqMQy1R` · `17 */4 * * *` (event-driven seat; 4-hour fallback per the maintainer's token rules of 2026-11-12).
- Assignee: os-lizheng → os-elon-musk. Leases: none yet (`a4-` prefix, table on the body); areas are cut from the cards' file roots in the next round.

Seated by forced takeover · 2026-11-21T15:18Z · `repo:objectstack` seat 4 taken by os-project-manager on the maintainer's word in this account's fleet project, verbatim: 「你现在的座位都下班，然后加载最新的技能，重开 objectstack 全仓座位」 then 「你接手他的工作」, the latter attached to seat 4's own hand-over (`session_016WV4d1PJ4isQ3eD7Fk1fnF`, 2026-11-21T13:27Z). The holder had announced clock-out (「当前任务处理完就下班呢」) but wrote no clock-out brief here, so this is a takeover (`project-forms.md` 接管), not a vacant-seat sit.
- Previous body: this post's revision before this edit (holder `os-elon-musk` · `session_016WV4d1PJ4isQ3eD7Fk1fnF`, leases a4-A/a4-B/a4-W/a4-C, L1-a).
- Assignee os-elon-musk → os-project-manager. Old mailbox #35555 closed; new mailbox PR #36124. Patrol `trig_013Uom3rDuEEEjwSoNxGyEod` (hourly, bound to this session). The old seat's patrol and area sessions live in another account and are not this seat's to delete; they stop acting on reading this takeover.
- Intake: the inherited work, then 「除了交接的工作，后续处理全仓非专题的 p1 任务，包括阻塞 p1 的任务」 (body).
- Each inherited card gets its own four-piece takeover comment (Release of the old claim, assignee swap, new Claim, hand-over record).
